name: portable-judgment-methods
description: Transfer human decision methods between AI environments without transferring personality or personal data.

interface.shortDescription: Run transferable human decision methods without copying identity.
interface.longDescription: A two-skill demonstration of portable human judgment: a general decision-audit engine and a seven-year, regime-based market decision system. The plugin separates method from personality, private memory, and personal data so the same reasoning structure can run in another AI environment.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show me how a human decision method can be transferred without transferring the person.
